metaDescription: Bondo is a computer store selling laptops, desktops, components and accessories.

hero.eyebrow: Built for people who read the spec sheet
hero.title: Components chosen on merit, not margin
hero.body: Every system we build is assembled, cable-managed and burned in for 24 hours before it ships — and leaves with its own test results attached, not the model's.
hero.panelBody: Every build runs a full day of thermal and stability testing before it is boxed.

featured.title: Featured this month
featured.description: The systems and parts our build team reaches for first.

deals.title: Today's deals
deals.description: Current promotions. Prices return to list when the promotion ends.
deals.emptyDescription: Nothing is discounted right now. Check back — deals rotate monthly.

valueProps.title: Why buy from Bondo
valueProps.description: Four things we do differently, all of which you can hold us to.

tested.title: Tested, not just assembled
tested.body: Every system runs 24 hours of thermal and stability testing. The results for your specific unit ship in the box.

answers.title: Answers with numbers in them
answers.body: Ask whether a cooler clears a memory kit and you get the height in millimetres, not a link to the product page.

packed.title: Packed for the courier it will meet
packed.body: Graphics cards are double-boxed with the connector supported. Nothing ships in a bag with a void in it.

returns.title: Thirty days, no argument
returns.body: Changed your mind or picked the wrong socket? Send it back unopened within thirty days and we refund it.

reviews.title: What customers say
reviews.description: Reviews from people who bought the product they are describing.

newsletter.title: Restock alerts, without the marketing
newsletter.body: Tell us once what you are waiting for and we will email when it is back. Twice a month at most, and nothing else.
newsletter.note: Unsubscribe in one click. We never share your address.
